text:
priya: Heads-up — after yesterday's sampler tweak in canary we saw a telemetry spike and weird PII counts. Unsure if sampler change or redactor ordering bug.

jess: Can you paste a sanitized example of an offending request/response?

priya: Minimal anonymized example pasted below — pattern is a money-transfer prompt where sometimes sensitive tokens are not getting masked before sampling.

priya: ```
request: { user_id: "u-***", prompt: "please transfer $500 to John at acct 4242-****" }
response: { text: "Done" }
```

priya: Current route config in canary looked like: 

priya: ```yaml
routing:
  route: /v1/generate
  sample_rate: 0.02
redaction:
  mode: partial_mask
  order: [scrub, pseudonymize]
```

ethan: Ordering will bite us here. If pseudonymize runs before scrub, scrub may not see original tokens to mask. I thought runtime enforces scrub-first.

jess: Our canary deployed a proxy-level sample hook that runs redaction at sample-time; could be a race with batch postprocessing.

maya: Console UX note — ops wants to see "effective sample rate" + an "expected unredacted pct" per route. They want cost impact estimate right in the rollout screen. :eyes:

priya: Ops flagged a retention/cost spike — quick calc shows ~+7% tokens logged in the canary window. Not huge but noticeable.

devex: We can add a small meter in the rollout panel that shows sampled logs/min and projects monthly cost. Also a one-click toggle to switch to pseudonymize-only for audit scenarios.

oncall-bot: DeployBot: canary/redact-fix v2 deployed to prod-canary-1 at 2024-08-15T13:42Z :white_check_mark:

ethan: Proposal: enforce pipeline ordering inside the proxy: scrub -> tokenization -> pseudonymize -> mask. Minimal perf hit, deterministic. I can put this behind an opt-in flag for canary.

priya: Sounds reasonable. Plan: opt-in sticky config at 1% traffic -> monitor 6h -> ramp 1% -> 25% -> 100% if no anomalies. Rollback if sampled_unredacted_ratio increases >0.5%.

jess: +1 to gradual ramp. Also document rollback path: `POST /api/admin/rollout/rollback` and add an "abort" button in the console. :+1:

maya: UX ask: show last 24h sampled vs unredacted ratio as a sparkline per route, and hide any "inspect" capability unless user has audit role. No global "unmask" button.

priya: Action items: ethan to implement ordering patch + unit tests; devex to add rollout meter & toggle UI; jess to add Prometheus panel and rollback endpoint docs. Reconvene after the 6h canary window.

ethan: Opening PR now, ETA ~2h.

jess: I'll wire up a prometheus panel: `sampled_unredacted_ratio` and add an alert if >0.5% over 15m.

priya: Thanks — tagging @security for awareness.

security: Noted. If this needs to run in Private (on-prem/VPC) variants, security requires HSM-gated audit access and no increase to retention without approval. Keep audit retention unchanged.

priya: Copy. I'll update the runbook and include the rollback play.

jess: One more note — let's also emit a per-sample metadata field `redaction_pipeline_version` so we can correlate later. Small index cost but helps debugging.

ethan: Good call. Will include header `X-Redact-Pipeline: v2` in sample logs.

priya: Perfect. Meeting-free check-in in 6h unless alerts trip. :seedling:
